title: Norms and Hermitian $\mathrm{K}$-Theory
summary: Over the past century, cohomology operations have played a crucial role in homotopy theory and its applications. A powerful framework for constructing such operations is the theory of commutative algebras in spectra. In this article, we discuss an algebro-geometric analogue of this framework, called the theory of normed algebras in motivic spectra.
